finding.surface: Renovaciones, navigation from Cobros and cross-module renewal lifecycle
finding.realSignedBrowserEvidence: A Chrome navigation to Renovaciones timed out; authenticated CI profiler logged 64053 protected store.get() calls for this route in a 6006d784 source comparison. Neither observation alone certifies all causes of latency.
finding.syntheticRepro: 1600 policies and 800 clients produced 27968 store.get('clientes',...) calls during one baseline render in a local isolated VM without any business writes.
finding.root: Country inheritance and synthetic QA lineage repeatedly called scoped store.get for the same client while filtering, assessing and rendering one portfolio. Each read incurred protected clone/scope overhead.

change.implementation: One scoped client index per render and lifecycle projection; per-projection core key and risk set memoization; no stored data mutation; reset render index in a finally guard.

localTests.note: Counts use isolated synthetic source fixture; live latency and authenticated persistence remain unproven until post-build verification.
